international_letter.description: standard letter, up to 20 g, to Canada (Correio Normal, 'Normalizado (só documentos)')
international_letter.notes: Normalised documents only (standard-size white or pale envelope, correctly addressed). Canada is listed (ISO code CA) in the 'Resto do Mundo' zone on the CTT zones page. Same page: >20g-50g normalised is 2,85 €; non-standard-format documents up to 20 g are 2,85 € and postal packet (goods and documents) 3,55 €.

transit_to_canada.text: cerca de 7 dias úteis (not counting customs clearance time, if needed)

notes_for_senders.fact: CTT zones page lists Canada in the 'Resto do Mundo' zone.

unverified_skipped: Delivery-time figure is the one stated on the Correio Normal page; the page gives no explicit effective date for 2026 prices (site links 'Conheça o Tarifário 2026').
VAC operator 'VFS Global' taken from the VAC website links (visa.vfsglobal.com/.../can) on the IRCC page; the IRCC page itself does not print the operator name.
